probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Skip to content Dario Castelli Architect, Milan Close Projects About Journal Contact [email protected] LinkedIn Instagram Overview A loggia is a room Date 3 November 2024 Topic Process Length 1 min read Next: Nine days in the salt pans Most balconies in new Milan flats are a metre deep. You can stand on one, or keep a bicycle on it, but you cannot live on it. Two and a half metres At Corte Vigentina we argued for loggias two and a half metres deep, big enough for a table and six chairs. The cooperative’s members voted for it over a larger kitchen. A year later We went back in June. Half the loggias had a table in them, a third had plants up to the ceiling and one had a piano. That is the point of a room: it becomes whatever people need. © 2026 Dario Castelli Milan, --:-- Terms Privacy Cookies Overview
